text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On that day, she was bouncing around full 
of energy as usual—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Instead, walking at a leisurely pace, they 
made their way to the Trainer's office.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Trainer, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: You know...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: ...My leg hurts. The left one this time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My memory of what happened immediately 
afterward is a bit hazy. I believe I 
called a cab. Marvelous Sunday and I 
headed to the hospital together. My heart 
ached with pain.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By the time my consciousness returned, the 
doctor was already standing right in front 
of me—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was informed that an injury had been 
discovered.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
As long as you get a few days of proper 
rest, you should have no trouble resuming 
regular training.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
However, whether she'll make a full 
recovery by the Challenge Cup in 
December... to be frank, is a gamble. It 
depends on her mindset and how she 
approaches things from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Of course, we will cooperate to the best 
of our ability. ...So please, don't let it 
get you down too much.
choice_data_list: I'm sorry, thank you so much...

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"...For the time being, we'd like 
Marvelous Sunday to stay admitted for 
further examinations."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing the paperwork and packing, 
I leave Marvelous Sunday in the hospital 
room and head home alone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bound by regret, my legs felt terribly 
heavy. If only I had realized sooner. If 
only I had paid closer attention.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can't just keep wallowing in regret. I 
need to reorganize our upcoming schedule.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though I thought that, I ended up spending 
the entire night unable to focus much on 
my work—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the next day, the moment visiting 
hours started, I was let in and headed 
straight to Marvelous Sunday's hospital 
room—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Trainer... Trainer, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —Being alone isn't good, you know.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Being alone in the pitch dark is no good.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I can't be surprised—I can't rejoice— 
There are no miracles, either—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Because... the marvelousness will run out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Deep down, I had been optimistic. 
Thinking she would still smile anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many physical ailments 
plagued her, no matter how many goals she 
had to let pass by... I believed that, if 
it was her, she would still smile through 
it all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“Still, that is not it. She simply views 
the world marvelously at all times, with a 
perspective that finds the positive even 
in painful moments—”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't that it didn't hurt, nor that it 
wasn't tough.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CRACK!!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I slap both of my cheeks with all my 
might. Infusing the strike with 
punishment, spirit, and resolve.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, while apologizing to Marvelous 
Sunday for startling her, I told her.
choice_data_list: Could you wait for me for a bit?
Could you wait a moment for me?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: ?? ...Should I just wait? Right here?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Until now, she has always given so much. 
Always striving her hardest, for everyone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Then—it's okay if it's my turn to receive.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
...Is it time yet? Not yet? Trainer, are 
you ready yet?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Not yet, huh—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: (Ah, being alone is no good.)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(Just like when I was little. A white bed. 
A white ceiling. The smell of medicine. 
All alone.)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: (It's dark—and cold—)
choice_data_list: Marvelous, sorry to keep you waiting!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Wah! ...Trainer, you look exhausted. Are 
you okay?
choice_data_list: It's fine! More importantly, look at this.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: This? ...A smartphone? Ah—a video?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Huh, could this be...

text_block_list.name: Feisty Classmate of Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
âAh, am I on already? Ah~... Umm, hello 
there.

text_block_list.name: Timid Classmate of Naribu
text_block_list.text:
"Did you forget about us, I wonder? ...No, 
you seem like the type who'd remember."

text_block_list.name: Feisty Classmate of Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Aha, I get what you mean. ...Umm, leaving 
messages and stuff really isn't my style 
though.

text_block_list.name: Feisty Classmate of Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"I'll show you how I run, so keep your 
eyes on me. —Here I go!!"

text_block_list.name: Brian's Classmates
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(The girls from Brian's generation that we 
talked about earlier! Incredible, they're 
getting faster... and stronger.)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(I haven't given up. I'm still chasing 
after it, even now—!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Fans
text_block_list.text: Marvelouu逐步s☆★

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous-san! The fans taught me so much, 
and they showed me footage of your races, 
and—

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
I've become a total fan. And because of 
that, I finally remembered!

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
"I remembered that I started this job 
because I wanted to create a place where 
everyone can smile!!"

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
"So right now—we're planning an even 
bigger fan event for you, Marvelous-san! 
Please let us pitch it to you once you're 
feeling better!"

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Boy
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, this is kinda embarrassing... 
*ahem*. Umm... Big sis, how've you been?

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Boy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, you got hurt, didn't you... That 
must be, like, super rough. ...But still!!

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Boy
text_block_list.text:
I'm all healed up! And I worked super hard 
on my rehab! Now, I can totally run again!

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Boy
text_block_list.text:
...After all, you're the big sis who got 
someone as rotten as me to run.

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Boy
text_block_list.text:
"Getting my own legs back in shape will be 
a breeze, absolutely!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
choice_data_list: …There's just a little more to go.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: The rest?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: (It's Trainer.)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(The usual trainer's office, with just me 
and Trainer. Trainer looked down, a bit 
embarrassed, but quickly looked back up.)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(She spoke with all her heart in front of 
the camera. Even with all the endurance 
and hardships along the way until now—)
choice_data_list: You've properly done everything you could.

You've properly done everything within 
your power.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(I did it properly. Marvelous is spreading 
properly. ...So there's no need to worry.)
choice_data_list:
So don't worry. You can still do it from 
here on out.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(We can spread the Marvelous even more. 
It's okay... Let's do this together, they 
said.)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Marvelous.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: ...Marvelous.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Uuuuuuuu~~~~...☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Marvelouu逐步s☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!! This is amazing☆ So amazing★ 
Amazing, amazing☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Seriously amazing ☆★☆ Guess what? Right 
now, I'm――

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Even more than before I got injured! Right 
now, I'm packed full of Marvelous!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I got hurt, sure! But right now, even with 
this injury, I'm so much happier! My heart 
is overflowing with so much joy and 
miracles!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: "So, yeah. Without a doubt!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Even this injury was marvelous, wasn't it!
choice_data_list: You're right. I'm sure that's it.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, Trainer. You HAVE to send me that 
video!”

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I'll treasure it. I'll look at it over and 
over. Whenever I'm lonely at night, again 
and again!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday had safely regained the 
sparkle in her expression.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The Challenge Cup was right around the 
corner. Yet, all my anxiety was gone."
